name: Drowned Domain
description: Pull the hostile mob you are directly looking at into a separate island dimension for 40 seconds. It remains persistent and permanently aggressive toward you for the entire domain. You begin inside a two-block-deep lagoon while the target starts on the raised circular sand arena. After five seconds, fast cannonballs snapshot the target's exact position every half-second and fly to that fixed point without homing; their 4.5-block blast radius is outlined before impact. Damage is 55% of your current attack damage, plus 1.5 per completed 10% Curse. You gain 50% movement speed, powerful swimming, Regeneration II and 50% lifesteal while inside. The cooldown is 5 seconds after the domain closes.
